designGuidanceBase: Check your boundary and house are showing — trace them on the main map if not.
designGuidanceSector: The land's energies — sun, wind, fire, water. Nothing to draw: check it matches what you know of your land.
designGuidanceWater: Start with water: place tanks by roofs, mark taps, draw swale lines across the slope.
designGuidanceEarthworks: Shape the ground: swales and berms along the contour, terraces and banks on the steep parts. Turn Contours on to see the lines to follow.
designGuidanceZones: Paint your zones — Zone 1 nearest the kitchen door, wilder as numbers grow. Tap "Where do my zones go?" if you want Lima's advice.
designGuidancePlanting: Trees south of beds so they don't shade them. Tap a tree, then tap the map.
designGuidanceStructures: Add sheds, pens, compost, beehives — mind the beehive flight path.
designGuidanceReview: Toggle layers to check each map: water, zones, planting.
designGuidanceGlossy: Glossy map (beta · experimental) — the AI isn't reliable yet, and you may need a few tries.
designGuideCelebration: Nice — ticked off. Here’s the next one.
designGuidePlanCropsHint: Just beds & trees? Jump straight to planning what to grow — you can always come back.
designPhotoIntro: Add a drone photo or any aerial photo of your land. You’ll be able to line it up and set the scale next.
designPhotoNotImage: That file is not a photo — please choose a JPEG or PNG.
designPhotoReadError: Could not read that photo — please try another file.
designPhotoOpenError: Could not open that photo — please try a JPEG or PNG.
designPhotoPrepareError: Could not prepare the photo for saving.
designPhotoSaveError: Could not save your photo — check you are signed in and try again.
designPhotoUnknownError: Something went wrong saving your photo.
designPhotoNorth: Turn the photo so the top faces north
designPhotoNotTurned: Not turned — leave this if the photo already faces north.
designPhotoScaleHelp: Tap two points in the photo that you know the real distance between — like two corners of a building, or two fence posts you can measure.
designPhotoEnterDistance: Now enter the real distance between them.
designPhotoPointInstruction: Tap point {point} of 2 on the photo. The photo will not move while you do.
designPhotoMoveInstruction: Drag the photo to move it. Fade it down to match it against the satellite underneath.
designStorageFull: Storage full — your design is NOT being saved. Free up space, then re-open.
designPhotoRemoveConfirm:
Remove your photo and go back to the satellite view?

Your design is not affected.
designPhotoRemoveTitle: Remove your photo and go back to the satellite. Your design is not affected.
designPhotoScaleKept: Keeping your existing scale — re-measure only if it looks wrong.
speciesPickerNoteBody: Not yet agronomist-reviewed. Use as a starting point.
speciesPickerFrostNote: Frost-tender trees and shrubs are hidden where the modeled minimum reaches freezing; check the planting spot for frost.
designAdvisorNothingToAdd: Lima had nothing to add on this one — your design looks sound.
designCanvasFlatContours: Ground reads flat here — no useful contours to show
designCanvasContourInterval: Approx. contours ~{interval} m apart — lay swales/vetiver along these lines

designCanvasBaseHidden: Site references: hidden — tap to show

designCanvasSectorShown: Sector energies: shown — tap to hide

designCanvasShowSatellite: Show the satellite instead of your photo

designCanvasPhotoHidden: Satellite: shown — tap for your own photo

designCanvasSelectingMultiple: Selecting multiple — tap items to add, then Delete
designCanvasMeasureHint: Tap two points for a distance, or keep tapping to measure along a path.
designCanvasMeasureAgain: Keep tapping to add legs to the path.
designZuluDraftNotice: Unreviewed isiZulu draft. English stays beside translated photo and canvas guidance. Guidance not yet translated remains in English.

designPaletteSnapTitle: Preview closing hairline seams with a neighbouring zone
designPaletteCleanupTitle: Preview straightening and evenly spacing the selected items

designPaletteSwaleLengthTitle: Measured along the line you drew

designSectorFrostNote: · frost settles low there on still, cold nights
designSectorOpenMap: Open this place on the map first to read its energies.

designTankMethod: From this site’s 30-yr rainfall, 0.80 roof runoff. A typical year — size up for drought.
designTankEnterValues: Enter a roof area and daily use to size your tanks.
designTankZuluDraftNotice: Unreviewed isiZulu draft. Read the English source beside each label and prompt; the sizing method remains in English.
designGlossyRenderingBackground: Rendering with gpt-image-2 in the background…
designGlossyBatchNote: Whole · Zones · Water · Planting · Structures. Site & Phasing stay exact; Sector and Earthworks each have an AI option on their own sheet — lands in your gallery in a few minutes.
designGlossyFinishHelp: Exact Canvas is free and instant, and draws every label, legend and line at full sheet resolution. AI Polished saves that exact master first, then spends one paid AI render painting the map artwork — your boundary, labels, legend, title block, north arrow and scale bar are drawn back on top by the app afterwards, never by the model. Neither choice ever changes your canvas design.
designGlossyFinishHelpFullTreatment: Full Treatment is shelved and shown here for review only: it runs AI Polished, then spends a second paid render over the finished artwork.
designGlossyExactAlt: Exact plan sheet of the design
designGlossyAiAlt: AI artist’s impression of the design
designGlossyPreviewHelp: Review the map, choose its finish, then export the sheets you need.
designGlossyChooseSavedMapsSite: Choose which site’s saved maps to show
designGlossyNoSavedRail: Nothing saved for this site yet. Render a sheet and it will stay here for download and reuse.
designGlossyExportIncludes: Legend · Scale bar · North arrow · Labels
designGlossyQualityMediumSub: about a quarter of the cost
designGlossyQualityNote: AI artwork can change or invent features. Source protections, labels and legend are applied afterwards, but compare positions and counts with your Exact Canvas map before using the illustration. Higher AI quality does not verify accuracy.
designGlossyExactCanvasHint: Your saved layout · ready to print
designGlossyAiHybridHint: AI-painted artwork · your labels & legend on top · 1 paid render
designGlossyFullTreatmentHint: A 2nd AI pass over the finished sheet · 2 paid renders
designGlossyInspectFullScreen: Tap the map to inspect it full screen
designGlossyNoSaved: No saved maps yet this session.
designGlossySavedOnDevice: Saved on this device — these stay here after you close the app.
designGlossyShareError: Could not share this map — use Download instead.
designGlossyGeminiNote: Drawn by Gemini Pro — an illustrated analysis over your real site. About a minute.
designGlossyExactFootnote: Drawn from your saved design, with your site image, boundary, planting, structures and labels.
designGlossyAnalysisFootnote: Gemini Pro · illustrated analysis — great to look at, less exact on geometry.
designGlossyEngineFootnote: {engine} · if the result looks off, generate again or switch engine (More options).
designGlossyExactVersion: Your canvas design is always the exact version.
designGlossyEmptyAll: Nothing drawn yet — trace your boundary and place some elements first.
designGlossyEmptyLayer: No {stepLower} found on this design, so there’s nothing to map — draw them on the {step} step first. (A {stepLower} map is built from your real {stepLower}, never guessed. If you HAVE drawn them and still see this, it’s a bug — please report it.)
designGlossyFallbackGemini: gpt-image-2 was unavailable — generated with Gemini Pro instead.
designGlossyRefreshed: Refreshed current sheet — preview updated in your gallery.
designGlossyNothingToPhase: Nothing to phase yet — trace your boundary and place some elements (water, beds, trees…) first. The implementation plan is built from your real design, never guessed.
designGlossyDoneExact: Done — {count} sheets in your gallery. Open it to view or Print the set.
designGlossyNothingToStyle: Nothing to style yet — trace your boundary and place some elements first.
designGlossyDoneStyle: Done — {count} {style} sheets in your gallery{fallback}. Open it to view or Print.
designGlossyZonesDone: Zones sheet done. Add water, planting or structures for more.
designGlossyNothingToRender: Nothing to render yet — place some elements first.
designGlossyBackgroundCount: Rendering {count} {sheets} in the background — they’ll appear in your gallery when ready (a few minutes). You can keep working.
designGlossyFullPolishProgress: Step 3 of 3 — GPT Image is polishing the complete {layer} hybrid sheet in {style}. The exact master and the AI hybrid both remain saved separately.
designGlossyBackgroundSheet: Rendering your {layer} sheet in the background — it’ll appear in your gallery when ready (a few minutes). You can keep working.
designGlossySectorPolishProgress: Step 3 of 3 — GPT Image is polishing the complete {sheet} hybrid sheet. The exact master and the AI hybrid both remain saved separately.
designGlossySectorHybrid: AI is painting the Sector Analysis hybrid underlayer; your measured bearings and legend lock back on top afterward. It’ll appear in your gallery when ready (a few minutes).
designGlossyBaseHybrid: Rendering your Existing Site hybrid in the background — the AI repaints the ground only; your boundary, roof and access stay exactly where they are. It’ll appear in your gallery when ready (a few minutes).
designGlossyPhasingPolish: Step 3 of 3 — GPT Image is polishing the complete Implementation & Phasing hybrid sheet. The exact master and the AI hybrid both remain saved separately.
designGlossyPhasingHybrid: AI is painting a decorative parchment background behind the phasing schedule; the complete schedule locks back on top afterwards. It’ll appear in your gallery when ready (a few minutes).
designGlossySavingExact: Step 1 of {total} — saving the exact geometry-locked map first (no AI cost)…
designGlossyPaintingHybrid: Step 2 of {total} — painting the AI hybrid underlayer, then locking your exact elements back on top…
designGlossyPreparingHybrid: Preparing a geometry-locked AI hybrid from this exact sheet…
designGlossyMissingHybrid: Your AI hybrid is finished and saved. The second polish pass was not started because you moved to a different sheet — open that sheet and choose Full Treatment to run it.
designGlossyStartingPolish: Step 3 of 3 — starting one paid gpt-image-2 polish pass over the AI hybrid…
designGlossyLostConnection: Lost connection to the background render — it may still finish in the background; reopen this step in a few minutes to check before paying for a re-run.
designGlossyAssembleError: The sheet rendered but could not be assembled on this device{detail} — tap Refresh to try again.
designGlossyRenderIncomplete: The render did not complete — please try again.
designGlossyResumeGaveUp: Your AI render finished, but opening it kept crashing the app, so the app has stopped reopening it automatically. You can keep designing. To collect it, set Render quality to Standard and generate again, or open this design on a computer.
journalWeightsLiveElsewhere: Harvest weights and sales go in My Records.

insightFrostExpected: Tshando tshi a lavhelelwa ({tempC}°C ya fhasi nga vhuria). Tsireledzani zwiliṅwa zwi sa konḓeleli tshando nga Ṱhangule–Khubvumedzi nga zwifukedzo na mitsho ya fhethu huṱuku yo lavhelesaho devhula.

summaryWarmWetSummer: Tshilimo tshi a fhisa nahone tshi na mvula; vhuria vhu a oma nahone a vhu na tshando tshihulwane, hu tshi vha na gomo lunzhi nga matsheloni. Mvula ya tshilimo i fulufhedzeaho na tshifhinga tshilapfu tshi si na tshando zwi ni konadzela u lima tshifhinga tshinzhi tsha ṅwaha — pulanani nga u ṱhogomela vhuria vhu omaho na mvula khulwane dza masiari nga tshilimo.
summaryReliableRainfall: Mvula i fulufhedzeaho ṅwaha woṱhe, mufhiso wa vhukati, nahone a hu na tshifhinga tshilapfu tsho omaho. Zwavhuḓi kha u bveledza zwiliṅwa zwinzhi nga u tevhekana — langani u thapha na malwadze u fhira gomelelo.
summaryWetMildWinter: Vhuria vhu na mvula nahone a vhu rothi nga maanḓa; tshilimo tshi a fhisa nahone tsho oma. Tshifhinga tshi rothaho tsha mvula ndi tshone tshifhinga tshaṋu tshihulwane tsha u lima; nga tshilimo hu ṱoḓea zwiliṅwa zwi konḓelelaho gomelelo kana zwi sheledzwaho.
summarySemiAridSteppe: Vhupo ha mahatsi vhu si na mvula nnzhi — mvula ya vhukati i tevhelaho khalaṅwaha nga maanḓa. U kuvhanganya maḓi na u fukedza mavu ndi zwa ndeme u engedza tshifhinga tsha u mela.
summaryAridDesert: Mikano ya soga ḽo omaho — mvula i si nnzhi nahone i sa fulufhedzei. U kuvhanganya maḓi hu fanela u fhaṱwa phanḓa ha u bveledza zwiḽiwa nga vhunzhi.
summaryHighAltitude: Fhethu ha nṱha hu re na vhuria vhu rothaho na tshifhinga tshipfufhi tsha u mela. Shumisani nga vhuḓalo mitsho ya fhethu huṱuku yo lavhelesaho ḓuvha na tshaka dzi konḓelelaho tshando.
